verdict.rationale: Pipedream MCP is a hosted remote MCP platform, so bridging a developer's local MCP server into it as a managed remote connection is a fair question for this product. The evidence covers only Pipedream's own hosted per-app MCP servers (remote.mcp.pipedream.net) and an API proxy that forwards requests to third-party API endpoints. Nothing documents tunneling, registering, or exposing a locally running MCP server through the platform.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bridge a locally running MCP server into the platform as a managed remote connection without deploying it
